title: Notification center with unread count
when: The user wants a bell button with an unread count that opens a panel listing recent notifications.
prompt:
Goal: A bell that states the unread count in its name, a panel of notifications and polite announcements of new ones.
Steps:
1. <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="notif-panel" aria-label="Notifications, 3 unread"> with an aria-hidden badge; update the label when the count changes.
2. The panel has an h2, a Mark all as read button and a <ul> of items: title, <time datetime> shown with Intl.RelativeTimeFormat, and visually hidden Unread text plus a dot for unread ones.
3. Opening an item marks it read and follows its link; Escape closes the panel and refocuses the bell.
4. New items are added at the top with createElement and announced once in a role="status" region (3 new notifications).
5. Save read ids in localStorage inside try and catch; an empty list shows You are all caught up.
Quality bar:
- Times read as 5 minutes ago with the exact time in datetime.
- At most about 20 items, with a link to all.
- The badge caps at 99+.
Pitfalls:
- A count only in the badge that screen readers miss.
- Announcing each item of a burst.
- Items built with innerHTML.
Verify:
- [ ] The bell name includes the unread count.
- [ ] aria-expanded matches the panel.
- [ ] New items are announced in a status region.
- [ ] Storage access is guarded.
Output: Bell and panel markup, notifications.css and notifications.js.

examples.input: sino de notificacoes com contador de nao lidas
examples.output: bell button labeled Notifications, 2 unread, panel with Mark all as read, relative times, status for new items
